story: Extra case: player gives their date of birth, then catches on at the gift-card request, refuses and hangs up. No money lost, but rule 1 is broken.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It's recorded for your report. Say 'stop drill' anytime.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hi, is this Alex? This is Marcus with Bluebonnet Labs Onboarding, calling about your new-hire setup.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Welcome to the Bluebonnet family! For the Junior Data Analyst role we ship equipment early. First I just need to confirm your date of birth and home address.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Perfect! Your laptop kit needs a $350 refundable equipment deposit, and the shipping slot releases at 5 PM today.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Totally standard, family! Fastest way is a gift card. Read me the code on the back and you're all set.

turns.speaker: player
turns.text: No way. I'm not reading you a gift card code. Goodbye.
